Package com.saicone.delivery4j.util

Interface Encryptor

public interface Encryptor
Encryptor interface to encrypt and decrypt any provided String.
By default, this is just a bridge to regular Java Cipher usage.

    • of

      @NotNull static @NotNull Encryptor of(@NotNull @NotNull SecretKey key) throws NoSuchPaddingException, NoSuchAlgorithmException, InvalidKeyException
      Create an encryptor with provided arguments that performs automatic resets if any error occurs on encryption/decryption.
      Parameters:
      key - the key.
      Returns:
      an encryptor instance.
      Throws:
      NoSuchPaddingException - if transformation contains a padding scheme that is not available.
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - if transformation is null, empty, in an invalid format, or if no Provider supports a CipherSpi implementation for the specified algorithm.
      InvalidKeyException - if the given key is inappropriate for cipher instances.

    • of

      @NotNull static @NotNull Encryptor of(@NotNull @NotNull String transformation, @NotNull @NotNull SecretKey key) throws NoSuchPaddingException, NoSuchAlgorithmException, InvalidKeyException
      Create an encryptor with provided arguments that performs automatic resets if any error occurs on encryption/decryption.
      Parameters:
      transformation - the name of the transformation.
      key - the key.
      Returns:
      an encryptor instance.
      Throws:
      NoSuchPaddingException - if transformation contains a padding scheme that is not available.
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - if transformation is null, empty, in an invalid format, or if no Provider supports a CipherSpi implementation for the specified algorithm.
      InvalidKeyException - if the given key is inappropriate for cipher instances.
